nom: Avène Tolerance Control Skin Recovery Cream

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the cream as very moisturizing and effective at calming dry patches and irritated areas, though several find it heavy or slow to absorb, especially under makeup.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers most often call this a holy grail that calms reactivity, itching and redness without stinging, but a minority report new itching, breakouts or worsened eczema after use.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers are split: some say it moisturizes without greasiness or breakouts, while others find it too rich and over-moisturizes their oilier patches.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports it works well even on oily areas without adding shine.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers describe it as rich, smoothing and effective for dry, sun-damaged or aging skin, though a couple find it too heavy to wear under makeup in warm weather.
segments.normal: Few reviewers identify as having normal skin, but one describes it as a light, hydrating everyday moisturizer with no issues.

concerns.aging: Reviewers with aging or sun-damaged skin report improved texture, softness and reduced redness over weeks to months of use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it is hydrating and leaves skin soft and dewy, though a few find it not moisturizing enough or, conversely, too rich and heavy for their preference.
concerns.redness: The large majority of rosacea and redness-prone reviewers report significant, often fast reduction in redness, flushing and burning; one reviewer says no moisturizer has stopped her face turning red and hot.
concerns.barrier: Many reviewers describe visible repair of a damaged skin barrier (from over-exfoliation, retinoids, or harsh products) within days to weeks, with soothing of burning and inflammation.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report reduced dry patches, eczema flares and flakiness on the face, eyebrows, and body, with one exception describing worsened eczema and spreading inflammation after use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers say it does not cause breakouts and even improves acne, cystic pimples or small bumps, but a few report new pimples, whiteheads or milia appearing after switching from the discontinued formula.
concerns.oiliness: One combination-skin reviewer notes it moisturizes without adding greasiness or shine, though another with combination/oily patches found it over-moisturizing.

aspects.libelle: Hard to fully dispense from tube
Reformulation seen as inferior to discontinued Extreme line

extraits.texte: I searched for years for something for my dry, patchy, rosacea skin that also still broke out. I came across Avène soothing skin cream. It changed my skin from red and patchy to beautiful, glowy skin! It was also a great primer. I used it it for two years, then they changed it to this one when the other was discontinued. I got a tube and immediately the patches were back along with pimples all over. I was so disappointed! When I looked at the ingredients and they had taken away good old mineral oil and replaced it with skin clogging beeswax and a few minor changes. I can't use it, as my skin looks awful with this. I'm still looking for about a year now and have not found anything to compare with the original formula. You will see the reviews of others that hate this new one. Bring it back!

extraits.titre: if you have sensitive skin use with caution!!!
extraits.texte: I bought this cream after searching for a good eczema safe moisturizer on the National Eczema Association's website. My first impressions with this product were great, the packaging is nice, and with a sealed pump dispenser, really easy to keep protected from bacteria or oils from your hands, and the formula goes on fantastic! it was very moisturizing, and my skin looked bright and dewy after applying on top of a lighter moisturizer (I have used this moisturizer for years btw, so what I'm about to say was definitely not the fault of that product.) HOWEVER. within minutes of applying my skin began to itch, even on my hands where I had pumped the product, and it got worse and more intense as the night went on. I woke up the next day with lots of skin texture and redness, and my preexisting eczema had become inflamed and had spread to my jawline. I'd say if you have mildly sensitive/non sensitive skin, this is a great moisturizer if you're looking to reduce dryness or redness from sun damage/ daily life, but if you're like me with extremely reactive/sensitive skin, then this "sensitive skin formula" may not be for you. < 3

extraits.titre: Dry, sensitive, acne prone holy grail
extraits.texte: I have extremely sensitive skin that often reacts negatively to skincare. This is the only moisturizer I am able to continually use that actually works for my skin. I am dry and acne prone. I will usually develop irritations to products as I continue to use them (just some examples - La Roche Posay cleanser, Cocokind moisturizers, Clinique moisturizers, Aveeno oat cleaners, First Aid Beauty moisturizer, the list goes on with high end and drugstore products that end in irritation and sometimes acne flares). This cream can be Applied during my most irritated times and does not burn one bit. This is truly the only item i am extremely loyal to and recommend to EVERYONE.

As a middle-aged woman with a giant patch of bright red rosacea on my face and a lifelong history of skin irritation to a number of things… I was very skeptical that anything was going to fix my issues. I bought this after my dermatologist recommended it, along with a different wash. After three months, 90% of my rosacea patches were gone. I use this twice a day and it does not break me out or sting or dry out my skin worse… And best of all it doesn't feel like I'm wearing a layer of cake frosting on my face! absolutely recommend five out of five.

extraits.titre: Worked well for my roommate but not for me
extraits.texte: This deeply moisturizes but was a little too heavy for me. I have true combination skin and so it over moisturized my oily patches. My roommate's skin is a little drier than mine and it worked beautifully for her. Non-irritating, absorbs easily, good dispensing mechanism so five stars since it worked so well for my roommate and was accurately described.

extraits.titre: Wonderful cream for very reactive and sensitive skins
extraits.texte: This cream is wonderful for my very sensitive and reactive skin. It has limited ingredients which is great for reactive skins, no fragrance and really softens and protects my skin. Other avene creams either has fragrance or mineral oil which causes acne on my combination skin. This is the only one I can use knowing that it will not cause sensitivity or any reaction and also it's a good moisturizer. Please don't stop selling this!!!

My dermatologist & his esthetician both recommended Avene products for my highly reactive, aging, super dry and sun damaged skin. I can honestly say the products have made an amazing improvement in my skin in just two short months!! I no longer have hot red blotchy skin on my face. I had daily rosacea like pustules which are also gone! My skin is soft and moisturized with out feeling greasy. I love this product! Please don't ever stop making it! Thank you!
